title: coord.py events: closed-field, reference-only messages and a wait that wakes any agent
goal: coord.py post --kind K adds an event to the store and coord.py wait --since N --timeout S returns the events after sequence N, blocking until one arrives or the timeout ends; the kinds are a closed list (claim, release, fact_added, gap_opened, dup_of, lesson, heartbeat) and each event carries only fields of ids (source ids, path:line fact keys, QK answer ids, backlog item ids, pack handles), so post refuses free text over a short field limit and any unknown kind with exit 2; a waiting process of any agent wakes on a post from another process on the same store.
